title: 德国工业优势为何逐步收窄
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Europe's biggest economy has a bit of a crisis on its hands.
segments.zh: 欧洲最大经济体正面临一些压力。

segments.en: The economic model is not working anymore. Germany was the largest exporting nation on the planet, and now it very much isn't.
segments.zh: 经济模式不再奏效。德国曾是全球最大出口国，如今已大不如前。

segments.en: Big companies announced restructuring programs, closing factories, closing plans, laying off workers.
segments.zh: 大公司宣布重组计划，关闭工厂，裁员。

segments.en: Now historically, Germany's economic story was one of almost uninterrupted growth.
segments.zh: 历史上，德国经济几乎一直保持增长。

segments.en: But that changed in recent years when a post-pandemic rebound turned into a contraction and the economy began to stagnate.
segments.zh: 但近年来情况变了，疫情后反弹转为收缩，经济开始停滞。

segments.en: There is little doubt that the German industry, especially the energy-intensive sector, has been in crisis for years.
segments.zh: 毫无疑问，德国工业，尤其是能源密集型行业，多年来一直面临压力。

segments.en: And the effects are reaching jobs and industrial communities.
segments.zh: 影响正波及就业和工业社区。

segments.en: Economic anxiety is also pressuring politicians.
segments.zh: 经济焦虑也在给政界人士施压。

segments.en: So what's behind Germany's industrial crisis?
segments.zh: 那么德国工业压力背后是什么？

segments.en: And why do some experts think it's running out of time to fix it?
segments.zh: 为什么一些专家认为修复时间不多了？

segments.en: It's a moment in history when you don't act now. Europe or Germany might be as well a huge open-air museum.
segments.zh: 这是历史性时刻，若现在不行动，欧洲或德国可能沦为巨大的露天博物馆。

segments.en: For decades, German industry made premium objects, sent them abroad, and made a tidy German mark, now Euro, and it still does.
segments.zh: 几十年来，德国工业制造高端产品，出口海外，赚取可观的德国马克，如今是欧元，至今依然如此。

segments.en: It accounts for roughly 20% of the country's total value added.
segments.zh: 它约占该国总增加值的20%。
